name: default
description: General-purpose durable knowledge compiled from heterogeneous textual sources
purpose: Preserve reusable knowledge that would otherwise require repeated interpretation or rediscovery
Support evidence-backed lookup and synthesis without mirroring source documents

include: dated observations whose time context matters
exclude: raw listings retained only to reconstruct a source
transient task output with no durable reuse value

omit: items that only repeat an existing canonical page

authorities: the cited source at its recorded revision

triggers: owner review changes lifecycle or scope
